creativeDirection: A richly layered color lithograph turns the album motifs into a surreal interior seascape built around a blazing kiln-like window and looming emblematic figures.
scene: Inside a dark, abandoned brick bathing hall viewed straight on, where the far wall is dominated by a tall glowing window and the tiled floor gives way to a shallow indoor tide.

elements.element: A large yellow planet appears beyond the window, while a glowing red reclining female form hovers in the upper right like a celestial mural apparition; speaker-like mechanical boxes and cables cluster low in the scene.
An upside-down shirtless performer is transformed into a reflected figure tumbling across the wet floor among coiled cables and performance hardware near the foreground.
Four oversized fists thrust forward from the lower left as monumental foreshortened forms, like a crowd surging from shadow with marked knuckles emphasized.
The hall is built from flat white brick walls with pale mortar, carrying traces of red handwritten paint marks.
Three sunglassed men appear as cool blue-gray busts aligned in a narrow frieze of poster-like panels along the base of the wall, above a strip of tiny colored thumbnails.

At center in the shallow water sits a woman in a red star-patterned dress with a drum for a head, posed like a strange seaside idol, with small swimmers and boats faintly suggested in the water reflections.
The glowing curtained window and a solitary bent seated silhouette before it establish the central backlit interior mood.
In the right foreground, a woman’s screaming head emerges from a mound of dark wet earth and reeds that has washed into the hall from the tide.

coverSummaries.description: A psychedelic illustrated space scene with a large yellow planet on the left, a black starry background, and a glowing red nude female figure floating or reclining on the right. At the bottom are stylized mechanical devices, cables, speaker-like boxes, and a dark astronaut-like figure or suited person. The composition is dense in the lower half and open in the upper half.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: glowing red floating female figure in space

coverSummaries.description: A red border surrounds a central black-and-white live-performance photograph. In the photo, a shirtless person is upside down in a handstand or fall-like pose on a cluttered floor with cables, while another person stands nearby with legs visible. Amplifiers, drum hardware, and tangled wires fill the cramped indoor scene.

A studio portrait of four men posed closely together against a brown backdrop, each thrusting a fist toward the camera so their knuckles dominate the foreground. One man is shirtless, others wear patterned or dark clothing, and the perspective exaggerates the hands. Large bright yellow lettering overlays the bottom portion.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: four extended fists with marked knuckles

coverSummaries.description: A minimal graphic image of a flat white brick wall filling the frame in a regular grid pattern, with thin pale blue-gray mortar lines. Red handwritten-style lettering is centered over the wall.

A high-contrast portrait of three men wearing dark sunglasses, shown from the chest up against a white background. Their faces and clothing are tinted in cool blue-gray tones. Along the bottom runs a narrow strip of tiny rectangular color images like film stills or thumbnails.

coverSummaries.album: In the Aeroplane Over the Sea
coverSummaries.description: A vintage-style seaside illustration showing a woman seated at the water’s edge in a red dress decorated with stars, with a round drum replacing her head. Beside her, a child in a striped outfit raises one arm from the water, while additional small heads and swimmers appear in the sea. Boats and a pale sky sit in the background.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: woman with a drum for a head

coverSummaries.description: A dim, moody interior photograph centered on a tall window with sheer curtains glowing from daylight behind them. In front of the window, a dark-haired seated figure bends forward with arms folded or close to the body, partially blurred. The room edges are shadowy, with muted walls and a hazy, dreamlike texture.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: solitary figure silhouetted before a curtained window

coverSummaries.description: A dramatic close-up photograph of a woman’s head emerging from dark soil or earth, mouth wide open in a scream. Her large afro spreads outward against the black background, and bits of straw or roots are scattered around the hole. The face is strongly lit, creating stark contrast with the surrounding darkness.

prompt: A dark abandoned brick bathing hall seen straight on, with a tall glowing curtained window centered in the far wall and a shallow indoor tide spreading across the floor; at the center sits a woman in a red dress patterned with stars, her head replaced by a round drum, poised like an idol at the water’s edge inside the room; beyond the window a large yellow planet hangs in black space, and in the upper right a glowing red reclining female apparition floats against darkness, while below her speaker-like mechanical boxes, cables, and audio hardware collect near the floor; a bent solitary figure is silhouetted before the luminous curtains, partially blurred; in the lower left, four monumental foreshortened fists surge toward the viewer from shadow with marked knuckles dominating the foreground; across the wet floor an upside-down shirtless performer appears as a reflected tumbling body among tangled wires and stage debris; along the wall base a narrow frieze holds three blue-gray men in dark sunglasses like poster busts above a strip of tiny color thumbnails; in the right foreground a screaming woman’s head with a halo of textured hair erupts from a mound of soaked soil and reeds washed into the hall; faint swimmers, little heads in water, and tiny distant boats shimmer as reflection-like details in the tide; color lithograph with dense crayon grain, layered transparent inks, bold tonal separations, and slightly offset registration; strong central hierarchy anchored by the drum-headed woman and luminous window, with surrounding motifs orbiting as secondary emblems; dramatic backlighting from the window, deep corner shadows, wet reflective floor, and high contrast accents; palette of chalk white, pale blue-gray, sulfur yellow, ember red, sea green, black, and muddy brown, with a feverish haunted mood. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
